quest.title: Backstage Helpers
quest.description: Thanks to you, the performance of Homeward, Bravebeard went smoothly, but it seems that Yinggong has something to say to you...

dialogues.speaker: Yinggong
dialogues.text: Such a great end to the play. You've done well, young one. How did you find it? Was it hard to perform with paper?

choices.text: It was a piece of cake.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Paper plays are different from Liyue Operas. Being able to do everything yourself makes things a lot simpler.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon thinks {NICKNAME} did pretty well. The script itself for the paper play is also very interesting! Paimon wants to see a new story. Yinggong, when will you perform next time?

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Haha, as long as someone enjoys it. As for next time, I don't know.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: You see, doing paper plays for kids is actually a hobby of mine. After this, I will return to the Yun-Han Opera Troupe to handle the wardrobe and props.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? You're with the Yun-Han Opera Troupe? So you can also sing Liyue Opera.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: I can, to some extent. Who wouldn't be able to carry a tune after staying with the Yun-Han Opera Troupe for so long? Of course, I'm nothing when compared to Ms. Yun.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: I actually work with the people behind the scenes. I'm in charge of the wardrobe and props on stage, such as cannons, flags, costumes, accessories, gadgets... Whatever prop you saw on stage, that was me.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Some of the costumes and props that the Yun-Han Opera Troupe uses today are hand-me-downs from the past, and others were bought or made by myself.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: To perform an entire Liyue Opera, there are a lot of people working on stage and behind the scenes. You can't make it happen with just a few actors and actresses.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: This year's Lantern Rite, Ms. Yun gave some of us backstage helpers some time off, and all of my colleagues are back home to spend the holidays.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: I've got all this time on my hands, so I decided to put on a paper play for the people here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You didn't go home?

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: No, I didn't go home. My mother and father passed away two years ago, so it's just me now.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Oh, there's nothing to be sorry about. I don't mind.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: I'm having a good time by myself at the Lantern Rite. As you can see, those kids loved my paper play.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We also enjoyed it!

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Of course I enjoyed it myself as well, otherwise I wouldn't have bothered making all the paper characters and paper settings.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Did you write the story yourself?

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Not really. Whether it's Liyue Operas, paper plays, or the Tea Master's stories, they all know the tale of the Bravebeard.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: In their moment of need, when people call for a hero, such heroes will answer the call to save the day.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Liyue has no shortage of such heroes. Just put a little spin on their story, and you have something to enjoy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon has heard a lot about this before. Is this part of Liyue's traditional culture?

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: Haha, yeah, that sounds about right.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: But while there are always heroes who help out in times of crisis, you can't keep relying on others and have to take responsibility for yourself.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: #Take care of yourself, {M#young man}{F#young lady}. Happy Lantern Rite!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I will. Happy Lantern Rite!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Happy Lantern Rite!

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: If you have time, come see an opera at the Yun-Han Opera Troupe. Maybe we'll see each other again there.

response.speaker: Yinggong
response.text: You're not a performer by trade, so of course you'd be bound to make some mistakes on your first try.
